name: Muhammad
title: The Messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets
sentTo: All of humanity and the jinn, until the end of time

places.name: Makkah, where he was born and received the first revelation.
Madinah, where he migrated, built the first Muslim community and is buried.

summary: The last of the Prophets, sent as a mercy to the worlds. He is the answer to the prayer of Ibrahim and Ismail and the good news given by Isa (AS). This is a short overview; his full life is told in the Seerah section of the app.
notes: This overview is deliberately short. For the Prophet's ﷺ life, open the Seerah section.

chapters.title: The Seal of the Prophets
paragraphs: Every Prophet before him prepared the way. Ibrahim and Ismail (AS), raising the Kaaba, prayed for a messenger from among their descendants. Isa (AS) gave good news of a messenger to come after him, named Ahmad. That messenger was Muhammad ﷺ, son of 'Abdullah, from the tribe of Quraysh in Makkah.
Allah says: “Muhammad is not the father of any of your men, but he is the Messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets.” No Prophet will come after him.

The Prophet ﷺ described himself with a beautiful example: the Prophets before him were like a man who built a fine house, complete except for one brick in a corner. People walked around it, admired it, and asked: “Why has this brick not been put in place?” He said: “I am that brick, and I am the Seal of the Prophets.”
kidsParagraphs: Our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is the last Prophet. No Prophet will come after him.
He said the Prophets were like a beautiful house with one missing brick, and he is that brick!

blocks.translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The example of me and the Prophets before me is that of a man who built a house and made it fine and beautiful, except for the place of one brick in a corner. People began to walk around it, admiring it and saying: ‘Why has this brick not been put in place?’ I am that brick, and I am the Seal of the Prophets.”

lessons: The message of all the Prophets was completed by Muhammad ﷺ.
Believing that he is the last Prophet is part of faith.
Love all the Prophets, and follow the last of them.

chapters.title: A mercy to the worlds
paragraphs: Allah says to him: “We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds,” and: “You are truly of a great character.”

He cared deeply for his people: “There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. It grieves him that you should suffer; he is concerned for you, and to the believers he is kind and merciful.”
He lived what he taught: honest when he was called al-Amin, patient when he was rejected, forgiving when he returned to Makkah in victory, and humble until the end.
kidsParagraphs: Allah sent our Prophet ﷺ as a mercy to everyone.
He was kind, honest and patient, and he cared about us very much.
lessons: Mercy is at the heart of his message.
Good character is the best way to follow him.
He cared for his Ummah; we show our love by following his Sunnah.

quiz.question: As what did Allah send the Prophet ﷺ, according to 21:107?

chapters.title: His message continues
paragraphs: Allah reminds the believers that Muhammad ﷺ was a messenger, like the messengers before him, and that his death would not be the end of the message: “Muhammad is only a messenger; messengers have passed away before him.”
He left behind the Quran and his Sunnah, and Companions who were “firm against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves”, always bowing and prostrating, seeking Allah's favour.
His life, from his birth in Makkah to the first revelation, the Hijrah, and his final years in Madinah, is told in detail in the Seerah section of this app.
kidsParagraphs: Our Prophet ﷺ left us the Quran and his Sunnah.
You can read his whole life story in the Seerah section!
lessons: The message lives on through the Quran and the Sunnah.
Following the Prophet ﷺ means following what he taught.
Learning his life is the best way to love him more.
